title: Visited positions and space on embedded tapes
statement: Let $M$ be a machine with $m$ work tapes, embed those tape indices into $k$ work-tape indices, and form a $k$-tape configuration from an $m$-tape configuration $c$ using arbitrary initial contents and head positions on the other tapes and an output prefix. For every time $t$ and every original tape index $i$, the set of positions visited by head $i$ in $M$ through time $t$ equals the set visited by head $\sigma(i)$ in the embedded simulation through time $t$; consequently, the numbers of distinct positions in those sets are equal.
hypotheses_covered: An embedding of the $m$ work-tape indices into the $k$ work-tape indices
A machine $M$, initial tape contents and head positions, an output prefix, and an $m$-tape configuration $c$
